title: Dinner and Show at El Palacio Andaluz
text: If you come to Seville, dining and watching the Flamenco Show at the Tablao Flamenco at El Palacio Andaluz is a more than recommended experience; the service is excellent, the dinner is exquisite, and the show is unmissable.
author: profhernanochoa

title: Spectacular flamenco
text: Excellent high-level show. The dancers and singers are top-notch.
author: marianadW6534AO

title: Magical
text:
We had a very nice evening at the Palacio Andaluz. 
Magnificent show and high-quality meal. Nice table with a candle and very friendly staff.
We can only recommend this activity!
author: Bellachichix

title: Very good, recommend
text: This was by far the best flamenco show I have seen. The performance was excellent, the food good.  The whole atmosphere made the evening

title: A must-do

title: Living Life

author: Rawyline_C

title: Exceptional show
text: I had already been to El Palacio Andaluz before and, upon returning to Seville after several years living in the United States, I was clear that I wanted to go again. I was also surprised to find the new Flamenco Dress Museum, which I didn't know about from my previous visit. The show was once again up to par, with magnificent dancers and musicians. This time I also chose the dinner option. Without a doubt, I would do it again.
author: 658marialuisaf

title: BEST SHOW IN SEVILLE
text:
We are from Galicia and it is the fifth year that we have gone to Seville and the fifth time that we have gone to the show with the tapas dinner at the Palacio Andaluz.
The welcome reception was very proper, attentive, and polite to us.
The theater is very well decorated and the layout of the tables and chairs allows for freedom of movement.
The tapas dinner was very delicious, of good quality, and in sufficient quantity.
The singers, musicians, and dancers are great professionals; congratulations to all. 
A show that I recommend to everyone. 
We will return.
author: V5769CSlolap

title: Exceptional show
text:
Exceptional show of incredible intensity. We were charmed by the work and the excellence of the dancers and singers. 
The meal is not exceptional but unlike some dinner/shows, it was not bad and it is always difficult to serve so many meals that suit everyone in a given time. 
We will keep a wonderful memory of this evening.
author: berouette95
